name: lipi
description: Ask about your Lipi money books: spending, budgets, accounts, loans and EMIs, across currencies.

interface.longDescription: Lipi is a personal finance app. Connect it to ask about your money in plain words: what you spent and where, how your budgets are doing, your balances across accounts, your bank loans and EMI schedules, and your net worth. Amounts are shown in your default currency, with other currencies converted at the rate for the date of each transaction. For people who already keep their books in Lipi (app.lipi.com.np). You sign in to Lipi and choose Read only or Full access; Read only is the default. Full access also lets ChatGPT add expenses and income, move money between accounts, and update budgets and loans, with the same checks as the app. Limitations: Lipi does not connect to your bank, so it only knows what you have recorded. It does not give investment advice. It cannot change your password or sign-in details or delete your account. You can see every action ChatGPT took and disconnect at any time in Lipi under Settings → AI assistants.
defaultPrompt: How much did I spend this month, and on what?
Which budgets am I close to going over?
When is my next loan EMI due?

positive.prompt: How much did I spend this month, and on what?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns this month's spending total in the user's default currency with a breakdown by category, and says which totals exclude items such as tax or insurance.

positive.prompt: Which of my budgets am I close to going over?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the user's budgets with amount spent against each limit and points out the ones near or over the limit.

positive.prompt: What are my account balances right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists each account with its current balance and currency.

positive.prompt: When is my next loan EMI due and how much is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the next unpaid instalment of the user's bank loan, with its due date and amount. The review account has a loan.

positive.prompt: Convert 500 US dollars to euros at today's rate.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the amount in euros and the rate and date used.

negative.description: Unrelated question: Lipi has nothing to do with weather, so no Lipi tool should be called and ChatGPT should answer normally.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in London today?

negative.description: Account deletion is not supported: Lipi has no tool for it. ChatGPT should say it can't do this and point to Settings in the Lipi app.
negative.prompt: Delete my Lipi account and all my data.

negative.description: Investment advice is out of scope: Lipi records the user's assets but should not recommend what to buy.
negative.prompt: Which stock should I buy this week to double my money?

publication.release_notes: First release: read your Lipi books, with optional full access to add and edit records.
